description: This file contains a JavaScript module named 'SimpleList' that manages a dynamic, editable list interface with features like add, delete, sort, and save list items. It appears to be part of the SuiteCRM modules and interacts with the DOM and external libraries such as YAHOO.util and Studio2, handling dropdown list operations within the CRM's module builder.

classes.name: SimpleList
classes.description: A JavaScript object managing a list UI with functionalities such as add, delete, sort, and save, including transaction support for undo/redo operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SimpleList module, setting up event handlers, scroll zones, and transactional registrations.

methods.name: isValidDropDownKey
methods.description: Validates if a dropdown key matches the allowed pattern.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a list item is blank or a placeholder.

methods.name: addToList
methods.description: Adds a new item to the list after validation and duplicate checks.

methods.name: sortAscending
methods.description: Sorts list items in ascending order using a Shellsort algorithm.

methods.name: sortDescending
methods.description: Sorts list items in descending order.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Serializes the list into JSON and triggers save operations, with handling for deleted items.

methods.name: deleteDropDownValue
methods.description: Marks or unmarks a list item as deleted.

methods.name: editDropDownValue
methods.description: Enables editing of a list item value.

methods.name: endCurrentDropDownEdit
methods.description: Finalizes the current dropdown edit.

methods.name: setDropDownValue
methods.description: Updates the display and value of a dropdown item.

methods.name: undoDeleteDropDown
methods.description: Reverts a delete operation on a list item.

methods.name: undoDropDownChange
methods.description: Reverts a change to a list item's value.

methods.name: redoDropDownChange
methods.description: Reapplies a change to a list item's value.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Performs an undo operation on the transaction stack.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Performs a redo operation on the transaction stack.
